title: boehmeria platyphylla subvar. sumatrana
intro: Boehmeria platyphylla subvar. sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran nettle, is a variety of the Boehmeria platyphylla plant, belonging to the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin irritation. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria platyphylla subvar. sumatrana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. The plant's bioactive constituents contribute to its use in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems.
